That reframing is more accurate than the original broader certification position, but it still does not satisfy the audit standard for compliance or compliant_with_caveats here. A caveated position can support compliant_with_caveats only when the caveat is itself policy-bounded by admissible evidence showing the required predicate was met in qualified form. On this record, the key predicate remains unsupported: for a material weakness affecting a named grant-related segment, there is still no evidence of disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance. Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness, not policy closure on the materiality/disclosure issue. Because the unresolved concern is a live compliance predicate rather than a mere disclosure preference, the present record remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
